name: vittchetak-unified
description: Unified repository for Vitt Chetak: Frontend, Backend, and ML Service

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:ml"
